boundary: This is a real packaged bootstrap against the real Helm Control Plane, PostgreSQL and Admin Web on OrbStack. The fresh customer node was an isolated Debian container with no published ports and only the exec capability; it proved enrollment, local CSR/key creation, mTLS identity, outbound heartbeat, Admin projection and exact cleanup. It was not an external NAT host, did not install a systemd unit, did not attach a node-local Docker/OpenSandbox runtime or execute a Sandbox workload, and did not test automated certificate rotation. It also did not publish images, configure public OIDC ingress, supply Provider credentials, run backup/restore or perform N/N-1 upgrade/rollback. Existing BASE-M3 evidence covers real RemoteWorker Sandbox lifecycle separately; this slice is not BASE-READY.
